label: Route falsified
detail: No C4/C8 does not imply the P13-free reduction; a checked 24-vertex witness has induced P13/P17 and a C16.

label: C4 degree bound
detail: If delta(delta-1)>n-1 then a C4 exists; this is an independently re-derived known-style baseline.

label: Rooted path exclusion
detail: No C4/C8 is expressed as exclusion of internally disjoint equal-endpoint paths of lengths 2 and 4.

label: Blocker or 27
detail: For fixed roots, length-4 paths share an internal blocker or the family has size at most 27.

label: Blocker or 25
detail: Under identical hypotheses, the bound improves from 27 to 25 and the forced-blocker threshold from 28 to 26.

label: Simple internal triples
detail: Under no C4, the internal-set map is injective; repeated internal triples and the repeated-Fano multiset obstruction are not graph-realizable.

label: Simple Fano excluded
detail: Under no C4, the seven-line simple Fano internal-set pattern is not realizable for fixed-root length-4 paths.
